name: opencode + rtk
description: Installs the opencode AI coding agent CLI and the rtk token-optimizing output proxy into /usr/local/bin, with optional rtk<->opencode wiring for the remote user.

opencodeVersion.description: opencode version to install ('latest' or a pinned version such as 1.17.9).

rtkInitOpencode.description: Run 'rtk init -g --opencode' for the remote user to wire rtk into opencode.
